properties.name: A seat learns the shared design moved before it writes over it
properties.statement: A session's live graph is a long-lived cache of the committed design export. Before that session writes the export back, reflow2 must tell it that the committed record has moved since it last synced — the way git refuses a non-fast-forward push rather than silently winning. A stale export is not a conflicting export, it is a complete one, so the merge driver merges it cleanly and the other seat's work disappears without a conflict marker.
